evidence: Extends synchronization primitives in `src/sync.h` and `src/sync.cpp` with `SharedMutex`, `SharedLock`, and non-LIFO lock tracking in `DEBUG_LOCKORDER`.
rationale: Adds new shared mutex and lock utilities along with deadlock-detection tracking to core locking infrastructure. Locking primitives are high-leverage shared components where correctness is critical to node stability across subsystems.
